cohort: Adolescent women aged 13 to 19 years who delivered at HSK Hospital, Bagalkot, India over a 5 year period, compared to a control group of primiparous mothers aged 20 to 29 years
finding: Adolescent pregnancy was associated with a significantly higher incidence of preterm birth, low birth weight, stillbirth, neonatal death, birth asphyxia, and respiratory distress syndrome.
